items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: Mongo was playing a gig in a little club in the Bronx and Chick Corea was the pianist

ctx.x: I was the one. I don’t know whether you read the story Herbie Hancock has told how it got to Mongo. Herbie had recorded “Watermelon Man” I think around the summer of ’92. And somewhere down the line Mongo was doing — oh I remember — Mongo was playing a gig in a little club in the Bronx and Chick Corea was the pianist but Chick had already given notice a long time ago that he wasn’t going to be available for that gig and Mongo was at Symphony Sid’s office and Donald Byrd was there. And when Donald Byrd heard that…

And Donald Byrd said to Herbie Hancock, “Play that little vamp ‘Watermelon Man.’” So Herbie played “Watermelon Man” and Mongo really liked it, told him to come by rehearsal, new rehearsals starting on Monday, which is the first rehearsal that I made with the band.
